name: Benchmark C 12-hour continuation
task_command:
Continue only the authorized BENCHMARK_C_ANALYTIC_MAGNETIC_6DOF campaign in H:\fluent. Read evidence/benchmark_C_longrun_state.json, the final state if present, and the newest events before any action. Stay quiet while state is unchanged or the solver is progressing. Do not launch a second solver, terminate unknown processes, change frozen physics, reopen A/B/source validation or enter Benchmark D. The scheduled Python supervisor owns solver launches and the original 12-hour deadline. Do not reset or extend it.

If RESOURCE_WAIT, verify the supervisor remains alive and resource checks are current. Allow it to wait for 22 GiB available RAM and 35 GiB disk; do not lower guards without measured evidence. Notify only on a meaningful resource failure/change, completion or required human action.

If AWAITING_REPAIR_REVIEW, read the archived failure and existing repair history. Diagnose the current single blocker autonomously. For orphan failure, recover exact time/COM/quaternion/omega and orphan coordinates, local cell sizes and donor ratios; compare the full pose/translation with the validated static envelope. Distinguish outside-envelope, local donor/receptor resolution, and transient connectivity. Local refinement needs evidence; automatic overset adaption requires an exact-pose static adequacy result. Never remesh the entire BOI on speculation or retry an unchanged case.

Use the live READY worker through live_cases/benchmark_C_analytic_6dof/session_command.json only via the supervisor repair-plan interface. Write evidence/benchmark_C_longrun/repair_plan.json atomically. Fields: failure_timestamp matching state.last_failure.timestamp; decision DIAGNOSE, REPAIR or HARD_BLOCKER; root_cause; evidence_files (existing paths relative to H:/fluent); job (existing script under scripts/); job_sha256; config (optional). REPAIR additionally requires concrete_change and configuration_sha256 of the actual resulting configuration. Preserve original failure files before changing anything. Plans must include only one specific minimal action, preserve native checkpoint COM/orientation/velocity, and obey the maximum two technically distinct repairs per failure class. Write HARD_BLOCKER with reason only if evidence proves frozen physics/human input is required or repairs are exhausted. Commit a verified repair milestone with only its files and push origin/main. A diagnostic job must return without advancing dynamics and store results; subsequent heartbeat reads those results and submits the next evidence-based action.

If a continuation job is running, monitor files only. If the supervisor itself has stopped unexpectedly, inspect scheduler stderr and state first, repair its concrete defect, then use scripts/run_benchmark_C_longrun.ps1 to resume within the SAME deadline. Do not blindly restart Fluent. Installed CLI capability is recorded in evidence/benchmark_C_longrun/codex_execution_capabilities.json; do not invent codex --continue or spawn unrelated sessions.

If AWAITING_VISUAL_REVIEW, use view_image to inspect the actual final PNG and representative first/middle/last GIF frames (extract them into a distinct review directory with PIL). Confirm nonblank robot/pipe, actual motion, readable fixed velocity scale and partial-failure labeling if applicable. Verify GIF frame count matches actual saved FieldData snapshots. Write evidence/benchmark_C_longrun/visual_review.json atomically with status PASS or FAIL, evidence paths, checks and timestamp. Do not call an uninspected render PASS. Supervisor then consolidates verified C/sensitivity/render milestones and pushes origin/main.

For COMPLETE, HARD_BLOCKER_REQUIRES_REVIEW, TIME_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or STOPPED_RESOURCE_BLOCKER, preserve final evidence, report the final campaign result briefly and pause this heartbeat. No new time budget is authorized. If main run failed before postprocessing and no worker is alive, diagnose the failure and use a specific reviewed postprocessing job if appropriate; never treat partial output as full 2 ms PASS.
last_result: Latest observed RESOURCE_WAIT; one model capacity error user-reported, not independently audited
mechanism: Codex app heartbeat, not a Windows solver task
